topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I shouldn't have been so surprised, really. Getting this gift from a former student, it's not the sort of thing one expects. As I held the small, clumsily wrapped package, a moment from the past bubbled up, unbidden. The times I spent guiding them, the patience, the effort. It seemed so distant, almost forgotten. Now, here was a reminder, tangible and warm. The card was simple, a few lines scribbled hastily, but the sentiment was clear. It made me think about all those moments, the impact I must have had, however small. The room felt a bit warmer, and the light seemed softer. I wonder if I ever truly understood what it meant to shape a life.
